d: Recruiting on behalf of: A leading training center

Talent Diamond is recruiting a skilled Microsoft Office and Computer Skills Trainer on behalf of a leading training center based in Jeddah. The trainer will teach individuals and corporate teams to use common workplace software confidently and effectively.

Courses may cover Microsoft Excel at beginner, intermediate, and advanced levels; formulas and functions; data sorting and validation; charts and pivot tables; Word document formatting; PowerPoint presentations; and general computer skills. Applicants with experience teaching Microsoft Office certification preparation may also be considered.
The trainer will create lesson plans, demonstrate software features, guide learners through practical exercises, and adjust instruction to suit different skill levels.

Requirements: Strong working knowledge of the software being taught; experience using it in a professional setting; clear communication and classroom skills; and the ability to create practical learning exercises. Microsoft certifications and previous adult-training experience are an advantage.
Trainers worldwide are welcome. Please state your location, delivery languages, and availability for in-person delivery in Jeddah, online delivery, or both.
